name: magicsword-mcp
description: Connect Claude Desktop to your MagicSword fleet, alerts, policies, and intelligence feeds.
long_description: Use MagicSword conversationally: inspect devices, investigate audit events and alerts, update existing policy rules, preview policy assignments, create private intelligence feeds, and manage indicators. Requires a MagicSword Enterprise organization and an API key from Settings → API Keys. Your key's scopes determine access. Start with read scopes and ask for a proposal before applying changes. Initial policy creation happens in the MagicSword portal. Policy assignments, agent upgrades, and enforcement switches include explicit confirmation steps.

api_key.title: MagicSword API key
api_key.description: Generate an Enterprise API key at https://www.magicsword.io/dashboard/settings?tab=api-keys. Start with read scopes for endpoints, alerts, and policies. This is separate from your device enrollment token.
